Terms of use

Terms for visiting this website and participating in FN Squad community spaces.

Scope and operator

FN Squad is an independent Malaysian creator and gaming community. WhatsApp, Discord and Minecraft have their own terms, privacy policies and minimum age requirements.

Acceptable use

Follow the community rules. Do not harass, defraud, dox or impersonate others, share harmful material, or attempt to interfere with the site or platforms. Moderators apply the published enforcement and appeal process.

Content and attribution

Creators and rights holders retain their rights. Credit the original source and obtain permission when required before reuse. Send rights and credit concerns through the editorial contact.

External links and privacy

Linked services operate separately and may change availability or require sign-in. Read the privacy notice before sending personal information or evidence.

Availability and corrections

Site content and community services may change or be interrupted. FreakyNews summaries link to the original sources. Use our correction process to flag an error.

Applicable rights and contact

Rights and duties under applicable law continue to apply. Contact FN Squad for questions or concerns.

Terma Penggunaan FN Squad

FN Squad ialah komuniti bebas di Malaysia. Patuhi peraturan komuniti serta terma dan had umur platform yang anda gunakan. Gangguan, penipuan, penyamaran dan pendedahan maklumat peribadi tanpa izin adalah dilarang.

Hak cipta kekal pada pemilik masing-masing. Nyatakan sumber asal dan dapatkan kebenaran jika perlu. Perkhidmatan dan kandungan boleh berubah. Hak di bawah undang-undang yang terpakai terus berkuat kuasa. Hubungi FN Squad bagi pertanyaan, aduan atau pembetulan.
